cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific subfolder
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added into a specific subfolder within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add new bookmark into root hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added directly into the root level of the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add new bookmark into a deeply nested folder
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added into a deeply nested folder within the hierarchy.

cases.title: Attempt to add bookmark with invalid URL
cases.description: Verify that adding a bookmark with an invalid or malformed URL is handled appropriately or rejected.

cases.title: Delete an existing bookmark
cases.description: Verify that an existing bookmark can be properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Delete the last remaining bookmark
cases.description: Verify that deleting the final remaining bookmark successfully removes it from the bookmarks file and all access points without leaving residual UI artifacts.

cases.title: Delete a bookmark currently open in a tab
cases.description: Verify the boundary scenario of deleting a bookmark whose target webpage is currently open in an active browser tab.

cases.title: Delete a non-existent bookmark
cases.description: Verify the abnormal scenario where an attempt is made to delete a bookmark that does not exist or has already been removed.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar and subsequently deleted from it.

cases.title: Add Bookmark to Full Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify the edge behavior when attempting to add a bookmark to a personal toolbar that has reached its maximum visual capacity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from Locked Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify the abnormal behavior when attempting to delete a bookmark from the personal toolbar while the toolbar is in a locked state.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder into a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy and verify it is successfully added.

cases.title: Insert empty bookmark folder
cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder with no items inside into the bookmarks hierarchy and verify correct creation.

cases.title: Insert folder at maximum allowed nesting depth
cases.description: Insert a new bookmark folder at the maximum allowed nesting depth boundary in the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Abnormal insert folder with duplicate name
cases.description: Attempt to insert a new bookmark folder with a duplicate name inside the same parent folder and verify that the system handles the conflict or rejects it appropriately.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark successfully causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Double-Click Bookmark with Blank URL
cases.description: Verify the edge behavior when double-clicking on a bookmark entry that has a blank URL.

cases.title: Double-Click Corrupted Bookmark Entry
cases.description: Verify the abnormal behavior when double-clicking on a corrupted bookmark entry.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks contain valid links
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links under normal conditions.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks with redirect URLs
cases.description: Verify default bookmarks packaged with the browser that contain redirect URLs resolve correctly.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks pointing to dead links
cases.description: Abnormal scenario testing default bookmarks packaged with the browser that point to dead or unreachable links.

cases.title: Save edited bookmark properties normally
cases.description: Edit the name and URL of an existing bookmark and verify that changes are saved successfully without losing item integrity.

cases.title: Save bookmark with maximum length name and URL
cases.description: Edit a bookmark with the maximum allowed character lengths for both name and URL, and verify successful saving without integrity loss.

cases.title: Save bookmark during sudden simulated storage failure
cases.description: Attempt to save bookmark edits while simulating a sudden storage write failure, and verify that item integrity is preserved or corruption is avoided.

cases.title: Delete a bookmarks folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete folder containing multiple subfolders and items
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder containing multiple subfolders and items is completely removed along with its contents.

cases.title: Delete a system-locked folder
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a system-locked bookmarks folder fails and preserves the folder.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators Normal Scenario
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added to and deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add Multiple Consecutive Separators Edge Scenario
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when adding multiple consecutive bookmark separators.

cases.title: Delete Non-Existent Separator Abnormal Scenario
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a non-existent separator handles the exception gracefully.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes persist after graceful browser restart
cases.description: Perform additions, deletions, and edits to bookmarks, then gracefully restart the browser and verify all changes persist correctly.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes persist after application crash
cases.description: Make modifications to bookmarks, simulate an unexpected application crash, restart the browser, and verify that changes are correctly retained.

cases.title: Verify behavior with corrupted profile storage on restart
cases.description: Modify bookmarks, introduce corruption into the profile storage file, restart the browser, and verify error handling and recovery behavior for bookmarks.

cases.title: Negative View Properties Execution for Bookmarks, Folders, and Separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution fails or is appropriately restricted (negative test) for individual bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Negative View Properties Execution on Mixed Selection
cases.description: Verify that executing view properties on a mixed selection containing bookmarks, folders, and separators behaves correctly according to negative constraints.

cases.title: Negative View Properties Execution on Uninitialized Item
cases.description: Verify the negative behavior of executing view properties on an uninitialized bookmark, folder, or separator item.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Normal
cases.description: Rename a bookmark inline successfully without using the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Edge Empty String
cases.description: Attempt to rename a bookmark inline with an empty string.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Boundary Max Characters
cases.description: Rename a bookmark inline using the maximum allowed characters.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Abnormal Invalid Trigger
cases.description: Attempt to cancel or perform inline rename via an invalid trigger action.

cases.title: Find bookmark using custom keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found by entering its user-defined custom keyword in the search or address bar.

cases.title: Find bookmark with keyword containing special characters
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark associated with a custom keyword containing special characters can be successfully found.

cases.title: Search for non-existent keyword
cases.description: Verify that searching for a non-existent custom keyword returns no matching bookmarks and handles the query appropriately.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column normally
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted in ascending and reverse-sorted in descending order when clicking a column header.

cases.title: Sort column with empty or null values
cases.description: Verify the sorting behavior when a column contains entries with empty or null values.

cases.title: Sort non-sortable column
cases.description: Verify that attempting to sort a non-sortable column is appropriately prevented or handled without error.

cases.title: Resize bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized normally to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Resize column to minimum width
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark column can be resized down to its minimum allowed width.

cases.title: Resize column to maximum width
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark column can be resized up to its maximum allowed width boundary.

cases.title: Resize non-resizable column
cases.description: Verify abnormal behavior when attempting to resize a column that is marked as non-resizable.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns Normal
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface.

cases.title: Hide All Columns Edge
cases.description: Verify the behavior when attempting to hide all available bookmark columns simultaneously.

cases.title: Hide Mandatory System Column Abnormal
cases.description: Verify that hiding a mandatory system column (such as the Name column) is blocked or prevented by the application.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks simultaneously
cases.description: Select and delete several bookmarks at the same time to ensure all selected entries are properly removed.

cases.title: Delete all bookmarks in a folder at once
cases.description: Perform a bulk deletion of all bookmarks contained within a specific folder.

cases.title: Delete selection containing locked items
cases.description: Attempt to delete a multi-selection of bookmarks where one or more items are locked or protected, verifying abnormal handling.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child item or folder.

cases.title: Allow dropping bookmark onto sibling node
cases.description: Verify that dropping a bookmark onto a valid sibling node functions correctly as an edge case.

cases.title: Abnormal attempt to force drop onto restricted node
cases.description: Verify that attempting to force-drop a bookmark onto restricted targets via abnormal API override is rejected.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, clearly distinct, and fully test the given requirements without any blockers or missing scenarios.

All requirements and test cases have been thoroughly reviewed. The test suite correctly covers all 18 requirements with valid test cases, proper descriptions, and appropriate boundary and negative scenarios. No blockers found.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Boundary Max Characters
cases.description: Rename a bookmark inline using the maximum allowed characters.

cases.title: Inline Rename Bookmark Abnormal Invalid Trigger
cases.description: Attempt to cancel or perform inline rename via an invalid trigger action.

cases.title: Find bookmark using custom keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found by entering its user-defined custom keyword in the search or address bar.

cases.title: Find bookmark with keyword containing special characters
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark associated with a custom keyword containing special characters can be successfully found.

cases.title: Search for non-existent keyword
cases.description: Verify that searching for a non-existent custom keyword returns no matching bookmarks and handles the query appropriately.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column normally
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted in ascending and reverse-sorted in descending order when clicking a column header.

cases.title: Sort column with empty or null values
cases.description: Verify the sorting behavior when a column contains entries with empty or null values.

cases.title: Sort non-sortable column
cases.description: Verify that attempting to sort a non-sortable column is appropriately prevented or handled without error.

cases.title: Resize bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized normally to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Resize column to minimum width
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark column can be resized down to its minimum allowed width.

cases.title: Resize column to maximum width
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark column can be resized up to its maximum allowed width boundary.

cases.title: Resize non-resizable column
cases.description: Verify abnormal behavior when attempting to resize a column that is marked as non-resizable.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns Normal
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface.

cases.title: Hide All Columns Edge
cases.description: Verify the behavior when attempting to hide all available bookmark columns simultaneously.

cases.title: Hide Mandatory System Column Abnormal
cases.description: Verify that hiding a mandatory system column (such as the Name column) is blocked or prevented by the application.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks simultaneously
cases.description: Select and delete several bookmarks at the same time to ensure all selected entries are properly removed.

cases.title: Delete all bookmarks in a folder at once
cases.description: Perform a bulk deletion of all bookmarks contained within a specific folder.

cases.title: Delete selection containing locked items
cases.description: Attempt to delete a multi-selection of bookmarks where one or more items are locked or protected, verifying abnormal handling.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder.

cases.title: Prevent dropping bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that a user cannot drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child item or folder.

cases.title: Allow dropping bookmark onto sibling node
cases.description: Verify that dropping a bookmark onto a valid sibling node functions correctly as an edge case.

cases.title: Abnormal attempt to force drop onto restricted node
cases.description: Verify that attempting to force-drop a bookmark onto restricted targets via abnormal API override is rejected.
